title: Skills Config
description: Defines external skill package subscriptions synced nightly into .claude/skills/<package>/.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON Schema.

description.description: Human-readable description of this configuration file.

packages.description: List of external skill packages to subscribe to.

name.description: Local directory name under .claude/skills/ where skills are synced.

path.description: Path within the repository where skill directories live.

ref.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or SHA) to sync from. Defaults to "main".

skills.description: List of skill directory names to sync from the package.
